description: Keep the session-recall index fresh — incremental re-index in the background at session start.

hooks.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/bin:$PATH"; sr=session-recall; pgrep -f "$sr index" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { command -v "$sr" >/dev/null 2>&1 && ("$sr" index >/tmp/session-recall-index.log 2>&1 &) || echo 'session-recall: CLI not on PATH - index not refreshed (see README: Keeping the index fresh)' >>/tmp/session-recall-index.log; }
